snippet_primary: "For Users who declare their domicile in Brazil, who make sales outside Brazilian territory and who generate a balance in Dollars, Hotmart together with its Third Party Partner (Payment Services Provider) will carry out automatic daily transfers of this available balance in Dollars to the Payment Account and issue electronic currency held by the User at SCD in Reais"
